description: Permanently deletes one Huasheng video. It disappears from the user's project list, cannot be restored through the public product, and credits already spent are not refunded. Use huasheng_get_project first, name the exact video to the user, and let the host ask for confirmation before calling this tool.

client_action_id.description: MCP App only: submission id; reuse for the same click. Models omit.

pid.description: The 15-digit id of the video to delete

ui_lang.description: MCP App only: follow-up language. Models omit.

name: huasheng_delete_project
title: Permanently delete a Huasheng video
